data.explanation: Jobcenter Musterlingen is inviting you to a meeting to discuss your current job situation. You must attend on the date and time given, at the location shown, and bring your CV (Lebenslauf). If you miss this appointment without an important reason (wichtiger Grund), your Bürgergeld will be reduced by 10% of the standard benefit rate (Regelbedarf) for one month, under § 32 SGB II. If you cannot attend, contact the Jobcenter as soon as possible to explain why and possibly reschedule.
